images.title: Buddha heads on the Lincoln Park lawn (owner photo, refs/inbox 2026-07-26)
images.author: owner
images.description: Owner's own photo, dropped in refs/inbox and filed here by task 125. Six or so big white sculpted BUDDHA HEADS sitting straight on an open sunlit lawn in Lincoln Park, no plinths — smooth domed skulls with deeply carved snail-curl hair, half-lidded serene faces, scaled roughly chest-to-head-height on a person. They are scattered loosely across the grass under big shade trees, not in a row, with Lake Shore Drive traffic and the north-lakefront high-rises behind. Reads as a temporary outdoor art installation on plain park lawn. NOT YET BUILT — queued as task 128.
